name: World’s Edge MU4 / Season 17 coarse reference model
limitations: Terrain elevation is a flat baseline or explicit unverified control surface, not recovered from RGB.
Brown atlas regions are unreviewed rock candidates; their mountain relief is an unverified geometric proxy, not measured elevation.
Building envelopes are unreviewed candidates; snow/rocks can be false positives and dark roofs can be absent.
Building height is a constant illustrative proxy; interiors, collision accuracy and metric dimensions are not established.
